summary: Private first class from Bayonne, New Jersey, killed in Germany in 1945 and awarded the Purple Heart; not a relative of John's Petriello family.
bio: Frank Anthony Petriello was born in 1926 and came from Bayonne, New Jersey. He served in the US Army in the Second World War as a private first class and was killed in Germany in 1945, receiving the Purple Heart. Despite the shared surname, he has been ruled out as a relative of John's Petriello family.
